capabilities: insert column blocks from the editor context menu or a hotkey
edit and reorder columns inline in Live Preview
resize columns by dragging dividers and save the ratios to Markdown
drag files into columns to create attachment links and embeds
resize and align images within columns
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; content is stored as Markdown comment structures so blocks stay readable if the plugin is disabled.
problem: Markdown has no native way to lay out content in side-by-side columns, so comparisons, dashboards, and image-plus-text layouts are hard to build in notes.
summary: A visual column layout editor that inserts multi-column blocks into Markdown notes, editable inline in Live Preview and rendered in Reading view.
